purpose: A Composer library that requires only PHP ^8.3, with a committed composer.lock of no packages and a composer.json test script. It runs in the newest Composer image whose PHP the constraint allows (composer:2.11, PHP 8.5), installs from the lock without Packagist, passes 9 of 9 tests, and the planted faults go in src/Cart.php and src/Discount.php, named after tests/CartTest.php and tests/DiscountTest.php. Nothing reaches the network, so the result is the same on every machine.
